Hello,

The delivery for ISIN US67066G1040 was DK’d: Goldman Sachs delivered 10,000 shares for USD 1,862,600, while your instruction was for 8,000 shares and USD 1,490,080.

Please check your latest allocation and any repair or inquiry, confirm the correct quantity and amount, and re-instruct if needed. The settlement date is November 19, 2026; same-day instructions are due by 11:30 ET.

Thank you.
